rule: D&H Brief Lives entries for women who later reigned as kings are the same individuals as the king-list rulers (README, 'Cross-source duplicates with pharaoh.se'). pipeline.authority.royal_women resolves a mention that lands on one of these entries to the king, through king_name, which must resolve to exactly one king in the claim graph; king_name is also a name of the entry, so either spelling reaches her.
